title: Visit Redemption Standard for KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
## Standard

**R1. Content of a visit.** A KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans visit covers the plan's oil change, with the plan level's oil type and quarts per visit, and the other services the plan level includes each visit. Extra quarts and synthetic upgrades are paid by the holder at the facility.

**R2. Plan, term and vehicle.** A visit is redeemed only on a plan whose status is active, before the expiration date (or within the plan's grace days after it for a visit booked before expiry) and below the expiration odometer, on the plan VIN.

**R3. Spacing.** Visits must be at least the plan level's minimum miles and minimum days apart, and no more than one visit is redeemed on a day.

**R4. Rolling 12-month maximum.** No more than the plan level's maximum visits are redeemed in any rolling 12 months. The count is the number of redeemed visits on the plan that have not been voided, in the 12 months ending on the service date, the visit being redeemed included.

**R5. Partial service.** A visit is used even when only part of its services is performed.

**R6. Fulfilment.** When the last visit is redeemed, the plan is fulfilled; the date of that last redemption is the date the plan closes.

## Conditions for one redemption, as the records show them

| Condition | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Plan status is active | The plan record |
| Service date is before the expiration date, or within the plan level's grace days after it for a visit booked before expiry | The service date on the repair order and the expiration date on the plan record |
| Odometer on the repair order is below the expiration odometer | The repair order and the plan record |
| The vehicle serviced is the plan VIN | The vehicle and the plan record |
| At least the minimum miles and the minimum days after the previous redeemed visit, and not on the same day as another redeemed visit | The plan's visit history |
| Redeemed visits not voided in the 12 months ending on the service date, this visit included, do not exceed the plan level's maximum | The plan's visit history |

Every row must hold for the visit to be redeemed.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates and readings)

The figures below are example inputs; spacing figures of 3000 miles and 60 calendar days, and the 12-month maximums, are those of the levels named.

1. **Days apart.** A previous visit was redeemed with a service date of 2026-01-10. A visit with a service date of 2026-03-11, the 60th calendar day after it, meets the day spacing; a visit on 2026-03-10, the 59th day, does not.
2. **Miles apart.** The previous redeemed visit's repair order shows 30000 miles. A visit at 33000 miles meets the mileage spacing; a visit at 32999 miles does not.
3. **Rolling maximum.** A KestrelCare Maintenance Starter plan, maximum 2 visits in any rolling 12 months, shows two redeemed visits not voided in the 12 months ending on the proposed service date. A third visit would make 3 in that period and is not redeemed. If one of those two redemptions had been voided, the count with the new visit would be 2, within the maximum.
4. **Grace days.** A KestrelCare Maintenance Plus plan, 7 grace days, has an expiration date of 2027-05-31. A visit booked before that date and performed on 2027-06-05, within 7 calendar days after the expiration date, may be redeemed if the other conditions hold. On a KestrelCare Maintenance Starter plan, whose grace is 0 days, a visit is redeemed only before the expiration date.
5. **Fulfilment.** A KestrelCare Maintenance Basic plan shows 1 visit remaining. When that visit is redeemed, 0 visits remain and the plan is fulfilled.
6. **Partial visit.** At a visit where only the tire rotation is performed, the visit is used and the plan's remaining visits fall by one.
